name: nn-agent-skills
description: Guided code review, as a terminal walkthrough or a single HTML report, plus evolutionary code optimization against a fitness function.

interface.shortDescription: Code review walkthroughs, review reports, and evolutionary code optimization.
interface.longDescription: Walk a branch or working-tree diff one logical change at a time in the terminal, drafting GitHub comments or applying verified fixes — or render the whole review as one self-contained HTML page with an overview, a GitHub-style diff, and per-change findings. Also generates diverse code mutations, evaluates them in isolated worktrees, and retains the strongest verified candidates in a MAP-Elites archive.
defaultPrompt: Review this branch interactively, one change at a time.
Review this branch and give me the review as a web page.
Review my local changes and fix the problems.
Optimize this function against a benchmark with Evolve.
